569	    async def _llm_step(self, turn: _Turn, messages: list[dict], run: Any, node: Any, attempt: int) -> Completion:
570	        """One LLM call (one attempt). Text is released as it streams. A failed call is logged
571	        and charged; it is retried (`_RetryStep`, after the backoff) only while none of its text
572	        has been released, retries are left and the turn still has tokens."""
573	        request = {"turn": turn.user_message["id"], "messages": list(messages),
574	                   "tools": [t["function"]["name"] for t in TOOL_SCHEMAS],
575	                   "reasoning_effort": self.llm.effort(turn.reasoning_effort)}
576	        started = time.monotonic()
577	        buffer = SentenceBuffer()
578	        think = ThinkSplitter()  # an inline <think> block (servers without reasoning_content)
579	        thought = ""
580	        released = False
581	        content = blank = ""
582	        received: int | None = None  # output characters, once any output arrived
583	
584	        def log_call(response: dict, usage: Any = None, *, output_chars: int | None = None,
585	                     no_response: bool = False) -> asyncio.Future:
586	            # every attempt counts against the turn's tokens, also failed ones and retries
587	            charged, estimated = turn.budget.charge(usage, messages, output_chars=output_chars,
588	                                                    no_response=no_response)
589	            response = {**response, "budget": {"charged_tokens": charged, "estimated": estimated,
590	                                               "turn_tokens": turn.budget.tokens}}
591	            # `tokens` = what the turn was charged, so the site's daily budget (§8.2) counts
592	            # estimated calls the same way (06 review P2-9); `response.usage` keeps the report
593	            return turn.threads.start(
594	                self.store.add_llm_call, turn.user_id, turn.conversation_id, request, response,
595	                latency_ms=int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000), tokens=charged,
596	                model=getattr(self.llm, "model", None))
597	
598	        def got(n: int) -> None:
599	            nonlocal received
600	            received = (received or 0) + n
601	
602	        def show(text: str) -> None:
603	            """Visible text: released sentence by sentence through the guard."""
604	            nonlocal content, blank, released
605	            content += text
606	            for sentence in buffer.push(text):
607	                if sentence.strip():
608	                    self._release(turn, blank + sentence, not released)
609	                    blank, released = "", True
610	                else:
611	                    blank += sentence  # white space is never sent on its own
612	
613	        try:
614	            # the per-call time limit; leaving the block (a guard failure, the limit, a
615	            # cancellation) closes the model's HTTP stream right away
616	            async with asyncio.timeout(self.llm_timeout):
617	                async with node.stream(run.ctx) as stream:
618	                    async for event in stream:
619	                        text = ""
620	                        if isinstance(event, PartStartEvent):
621	                            part = event.part
622	                            if isinstance(part, TextPart):
623	                                text = part.content
624	                            elif isinstance(part, ThinkingPart):
625	                                got(len(part.content))
626	                            elif isinstance(part, ToolCallPart):
627	                                got(len(part.tool_name) + len(part.args_as_json_str() if part.args else ""))
628	                        elif isinstance(event, PartDeltaEvent):
629	                            delta = event.delta
630	                            if isinstance(delta, TextPartDelta):
631	                                text = delta.content_delta
632	                            elif isinstance(delta, ThinkingPartDelta):
633	                                got(len(delta.content_delta or ""))
634	                            elif isinstance(delta, ToolCallPartDelta):
635	                                args = delta.args_delta
636	                                got(len(delta.tool_name_delta or "")
637	                                    + len(args if isinstance(args, str) else json.dumps(args or {})))
638	                        if not text:
639	                            continue
640	                        got(len(text))
641	                        text, inline = think.feed(text)
642	                        thought += inline
643	                        show(text)
644	                    response = stream.response
645	                text, inline = think.finish()
646	                thought += inline
647	                show(text)
648	                completion = Completion.from_response(response, content)
649	                completion.reasoning += thought
650	                if completion.finish_reason is None:  # the stream ended early (no finish reason)
651	                    raise LLMError("LLM stream ended without a finish_reason", retryable=True,
652	                                   received=completion.output_chars, usage=completion.usage)
653	                rest = buffer.flush()
654	                if rest.strip():
655	                    self._release(turn, blank + rest, not released)
656	        except _GuardFailed as failed:
657	            # the stream was cut by us; how much (hidden) output it produced is unknown
658	            await asyncio.shield(log_call({"content": content, "guard_problems": failed.problems,
659	                                           "aborted": True}))
660	            raise
661	        except asyncio.CancelledError:
662	            # the turn's time limit, a cancellation or shutdown interrupted this call: it is still
663	            # recorded and charged (06 review P2-4); `_drain` waits for the record to be written
664	            log_call({"content": content, "aborted": "cancelled" if turn.cancelled else "turn_timeout"})
665	            raise
666	        except (LLMError, TimeoutError, ModelAPIError, UnexpectedModelBehavior) as exc:
667	            if isinstance(exc, TimeoutError):  # this call's own time limit: output unknown
668	                error, usage, received = LLMError("LLM call timed out", retryable=True), None, None
669	            else:
670	                error = llm_error(exc, received=received, scrub=self.llm.config.api_key)
671	                usage = error.usage
672	                received = error.received if error.received is not None else (len(content) or None)
673	            await asyncio.shield(log_call(
674	                {"content": content, "error": str(error)[:300], "attempt": attempt + 1}, usage,
675	                output_chars=received, no_response=not isinstance(exc, TimeoutError) and received is None))
676	            if released or not error.retryable or attempt == self.retries:
677	                raise error from None
678	            if (stop := turn.budget.out_of_tokens()) is not None:
679	                raise _Stopped([stop]) from None  # no retry past the token cap (P2-2)
680	            await self._sleep(self.backoff * 2 ** attempt)
681	            raise _RetryStep() from None
682	        record = completion.as_record()
683	        if _flooded(completion, self.budget):
684	            record["tool_calls_not_run"] = True  # build_context skips this completion
685	        await asyncio.shield(log_call(record, completion.usage, output_chars=completion.output_chars))
686	        return completion
687	
688	    def _city_index(self) -> CityIndex:
689	        """City names for the guard, from the airline's current network (rebuilt when
690	        locations.db changes)."""
691	        net = self._networks.current()
692	        if self._index is None or self._index[0] != net.fingerprint.id:
693	            self._index = (net.fingerprint.id, CityIndex(net.cities))
694	        return self._index[1]
695	
696	
697	def _flooded(completion: Completion, budget: AgentBudget) -> bool:
698	    """More tool calls in one completion than any honest step needs (P2-3)."""
699	    return len(completion.tool_calls) > budget.max_tool_calls_per_step * FLOOD_FACTOR

"""The agent loop (design §4): one chat turn as a stream of contract SSE events.

    user message stored -> [LLM -> tools -> cards]* -> guarded text -> assistant message stored

The LLM chooses tools and writes text; routes, prices and tickets come from the airline through
the four tools. Text is released sentence by sentence after the ReplyGuard traced every number
and city in it; the first problem replaces the whole reply with a code template. The turn's
quote cards become bookable only when `Airline.post_assistant_message` stores them (`done`).

Runtime (ADR-001): Pydantic AI runs the model stream and dispatches the tool calls
(`Agent.iter` + `node.stream`); this module decides everything else - budgets, retries and their
charges, the guard, cards, app.db records, time limits, cancellation and the worker-thread drain.

Nothing here can book: the loop talks to the airline through `Toolbox` (four tools, no booking)
and `post_assistant_message`. Booking is the HTTP endpoint's call, caused by the user's click.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import logging
import time
from contextlib import contextmanager
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace
from typing import Any, AsyncIterator, Awaitable, Callable, Iterator

from pydantic_ai import Agent as _Runtime
from pydantic_ai import InstrumentationSettings, RunContext, Tool
from pydantic_ai.capabilities import AbstractCapability, Instrumentation
from pydantic_ai.exceptions import ModelAPIError, UnexpectedModelBehavior
from pydantic_ai.messages import (FunctionToolResultEvent, PartDeltaEvent, PartStartEvent,
                                  TextPart, TextPartDelta, ThinkingPart, ThinkingPartDelta, ToolCallPart,
                                  ToolCallPartDelta)

from ..airline import ConversationBusy, NotFound
from .budget import AgentBudget, BudgetTracker, refusal
from .concurrency import ServerBusy, Threads, TurnConcurrency, TurnSlots
from .config import EFFORTS
from .context import build_context
from .guard import CityIndex, ReplyGuard, SentenceBuffer
from .model import ChatModel, Completion, LLMError, ThinkSplitter, llm_error, to_model_messages
from .prompt import system_prompt
from .templates import CLICK_TO_BOOK, fallback_reply
from .tools import DEFAULT_STATUS, STATUS_TEXT, TOOL_SCHEMAS, MAX_RAW_ARGUMENTS, Outcome, Toolbox

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

DEFAULT_BUDGET = AgentBudget()
MAX_STEPS = DEFAULT_BUDGET.max_steps
TURN_TIMEOUT = DEFAULT_BUDGET.max_turn_seconds  # a whole turn (all LLM calls, tools, retries); then the template reply
LOCK_TIMEOUT = 10.0  # waiting for another turn of the same conversation; then conversation_busy
DRAIN_TIMEOUT = 30.0  # after the turn's time limit: waiting for its worker threads (design §4.9)
MAX_USER_CHARS = 2000
TITLE_CHARS = 60
LLM_UNAVAILABLE = "The assistant is temporarily unavailable. Your message was saved; please try again."
BUSY = "This conversation is still working on your previous message. Please try again in a moment."
SERVER_BUSY = "The assistant is busy right now. Your message was not sent; please try again in a moment."
INTERNAL = "Something went wrong. Your message was saved; please try again."
NOT_STORED = "Something went wrong and your message was not saved. Please try again in a moment."
USER_BUSY = ("Your other conversations are still working on earlier messages. "
             "Please wait for a reply there, then try again.")
FLOOD_FACTOR = 4  # a completion with more than max_tool_calls_per_step * this many calls runs none
SDK_TOOL_RETRIES = 1000  # the SDK's own per-tool retry cap; our budget ends a turn long before
_RAW = "__raw__"  # arguments the SDK could not parse, handed to Toolbox.run as the raw string


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Event:
    """One SSE event of docs/api/contract.md: `name` and its JSON `data`."""

    name: str
    data: dict


class _Stopped(Exception):
    """The step ends the turn with the template reply for `problems`."""

    def __init__(self, problems: list[dict]):
        super().__init__(problems[0]["kind"])
        self.problems = problems


class _GuardFailed(_Stopped):
    """The ReplyGuard refused the text."""


class _RetryStep(Exception):
    """The LLM call of a step failed before any of its text was released: call again."""


class _UserBusy(Exception):
    """The user already has `max_turns_per_user` turns running."""


class _NotStored(Exception):
    """Storing the user's message failed: nothing of the turn exists."""


@dataclass
class _Turn:
    """One turn's state. It is also the run's `deps`: the tools take the user and the
    conversation from here, never from the model's arguments."""

    user_id: str
    conversation_id: str
    user_message: dict
    guard: ReplyGuard
    emit: Callable[[str, dict], None]
    budget: BudgetTracker = field(default_factory=lambda: BudgetTracker(DEFAULT_BUDGET))
    reasoning_effort: str | None = None  # per-request thinking level; None = the client's default
    text: str = ""  # released so far
    cards: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    outcomes: list[Outcome] = field(default_factory=list)
    threads: Threads = field(default_factory=Threads)  # blocking calls inside the time limit
    # the tool calls of the current step (raw arguments), their results by tool_call_id, and how
    # many of them already have their tool_calls row
    step_calls: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    step_results: dict[str, Outcome] = field(default_factory=dict)
    step_logged: int = 0
    exhausted: bool = False  # a call was refused because the turn's calls were used up
    messages: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)  # the context, OpenAI shape (see `_WireContext`)
    steps_task: asyncio.Future | None = None
    cancelled: bool = False  # `Agent.cancel` was called


def message_view(message: dict) -> dict:
    """Contract `Message` of a stored row without quote cards (user messages)."""
    return {"id": message["id"], "role": message["role"], "text": message["text"],
            "cards": list(message["cards"]), "created_at": message["created_at"]}


class _RawArguments(AbstractCapability[Any]):
    """Arguments that are not a JSON object reach the tool as the raw string (`Toolbox.run`
    answers `invalid_arguments`, as before) instead of the SDK's own retry prompt."""

    async def before_tool_validate(self, ctx, *, call, tool_def, args):  # type: ignore[override]
        if isinstance(args, dict):
            return args
        try:
            value = json.loads(args) if isinstance(args, str) and args.strip() else {}
        except (ValueError, RecursionError):
            value = None
        return value if isinstance(value, dict) else {_RAW: args if isinstance(args, str) else ""}


class _WireContext(AbstractCapability[Any]):
    """Every request carries the loop's own context (`_Turn.messages`: app.db history plus this
    turn's steps, in the OpenAI shape) rather than the SDK's copy of it. So the wire is what it
    was before ADR-001: tool calls in their wire-safe form (`wire_tool_call`, review #11), our
    JSON for every tool result (also `unknown_tool` and budget refusals), and the reasoning of
    earlier steps passed back verbatim."""

    async def before_model_request(self, ctx, request_context):  # type: ignore[override]
        return replace(request_context, messages=to_model_messages(ctx.deps.messages))


class Agent:
    def __init__(self, airline: Any, llm: ChatModel, *, budget: AgentBudget | None = None,
                 max_steps: int | None = None,
                 ping_interval: float = 15.0, retries: int = 2, backoff: float = 0.5,
                 llm_timeout: float = 60.0, turn_timeout: float | None = None,
                 lock_timeout: float | None = LOCK_TIMEOUT,
                 concurrency: TurnConcurrency | None = None, drain_timeout: float = DRAIN_TIMEOUT,
                 sleep: Callable[[float], Awaitable[None]] = asyncio.sleep,
                 tracer_provider: Any = None):
        """`budget`: the per-turn limits (design §4.8; default `AgentBudget()`). `max_steps` and
        `turn_timeout` override its fields (tests, older callers). `concurrency`: the server-wide
        limit on running turns (design §4.9; default `TurnConcurrency()`). `drain_timeout`: how
        long a cut-short turn waits for its worker threads before it ends anyway.
        `tracer_provider`: an OpenTelemetry TracerProvider for the runtime's spans (entry point for
        #35). None (default): no instrumentation at all, nothing is traced or exported."""
        budget = budget or DEFAULT_BUDGET
        if max_steps is not None:
            budget = replace(budget, max_steps=max_steps)
        if turn_timeout is not None:
            budget = replace(budget, max_turn_seconds=turn_timeout)
        self.budget = budget
        self.llm = llm
        self.store = airline.store
        self.ping_interval = ping_interval
        self.retries = retries
        self.backoff = backoff
        self.llm_timeout = llm_timeout
        self.lock_timeout = lock_timeout
        self.slots = TurnSlots(concurrency or TurnConcurrency())
        self.drain_timeout = drain_timeout
        self._sleep = sleep
        self._tools = Toolbox(airline)
        # The only other things the loop takes from the airline. No reference to the Airline
        # object itself is kept.
        self._post_assistant_message = airline.post_assistant_message
        self._locks = airline.locks
        self._networks = airline.networks
        self._index: tuple[str, CityIndex] | None = None
        self._tasks: set[asyncio.Task] = set()
        self._user_turns: dict[str, int] = {}  # user id -> running turns (event loop only)
        self._running: dict[str, _Turn] = {}  # conversation id -> its running turn
        capabilities: list[Any] = [_RawArguments(), _WireContext()]
        if tracer_provider is not None:
            capabilities.append(Instrumentation(InstrumentationSettings(
                tracer_provider=tracer_provider, include_content=False)))
        self._runtime: _Runtime[_Turn, str] = _Runtime(
            llm.chat, deps_type=_Turn, tools=self._sdk_tools(), capabilities=capabilities,
            retries=SDK_TOOL_RETRIES, name="ocean-above")

    @property
    def max_steps(self) -> int:
        return self.budget.max_steps

    @property
    def turn_timeout(self) -> float:
        return self.budget.max_turn_seconds

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ public -------------
    def stream_turn(self, user_id: str, conversation_id: str, text: str, *,
                    reasoning_effort: str | None = None,
                    on_not_stored: Callable[[], Any] | None = None,
                    on_server_busy: Callable[[], Any] | None = None,
                    owner_checked: bool = False) -> AsyncIterator[Event]:
        """Start a turn and return its events: `user_message`, then `status` / `card` / `delta` /
        `replace` / `ping`, ending with exactly one `done` or `error`.

        `reasoning_effort` overrides the LLM's thinking level for this turn (none / low / high /
        max; None = configured default). `on_not_stored`: a blocking callable run (in a worker
        thread, before the event is sent) when the turn ends before the user's message was
        stored: refused with `server_busy`, or app.db failed to store the message
        (`internal_error`) - the API gives the day's message slot back there. It runs even when
        nobody reads the stream. `on_server_busy` is its older name.
        `owner_checked`: the caller already checked (off the event loop) that the conversation is
        the user's, so this method reads nothing from app.db (06 review P2-9); the turn's own
        writes still check ownership.

        Raises before anything is stored: NotFound (not the user's conversation), ValueError
        (empty or too long text, unknown reasoning_effort). Must be called on the event loop. The turn runs in its own
        task: it finishes and is stored even when the client stops reading."""
        if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():
            raise ValueError("text must not be empty")
        text = text.strip()
        if len(text) > MAX_USER_CHARS:
            raise ValueError(f"text is longer than {MAX_USER_CHARS} characters")
        if reasoning_effort is not None and reasoning_effort not in EFFORTS:
            raise ValueError(f"reasoning_effort must be one of {', '.join(EFFORTS)}")
        if not owner_checked and self.store.get_conversation(user_id, conversation_id) is None:
            raise NotFound(conversation_id)
        queue: asyncio.Queue[Event | None] = asyncio.Queue()
        task = asyncio.get_running_loop().create_task(
            self._run(user_id, conversation_id, text, reasoning_effort, queue, on_not_stored or on_server_busy))
        self._tasks.add(task)
        task.add_done_callback(self._tasks.discard)
        return self._events(queue)

    def cancel(self, user_id: str, conversation_id: str) -> bool:
        """Cancel the running turn of the user's conversation (the runtime side of #48's Stop).
        The model's HTTP stream is closed and no further LLM request or tool call starts. Tool
        threads that already started run to their end and are drained before the turn stores
        its reply (the template, problem `cancelled`) and releases the conversation lock and its
        slot. False when this user has no running turn in that conversation. Event loop only."""
        turn = self._running.get(conversation_id)
        if turn is None or turn.user_id != user_id or turn.steps_task is None or turn.steps_task.done():
            return False
        turn.cancelled = True
        turn.steps_task.cancel()
        return True

    async def wait_idle(self) -> None:
        """Wait for every running turn (shutdown, tests)."""
        while pending := [t for t in self._tasks if not t.done()]:
            await asyncio.wait(pending)

    async def _events(self, queue: asyncio.Queue) -> AsyncIterator[Event]:
        while True:
            try:
                event = await asyncio.wait_for(queue.get(), self.ping_interval)
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                yield Event("ping", {})
                continue
            if event is None:
                return
            yield event

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ one turn -----------
    async def _run(self, user_id: str, conversation_id: str, text: str, reasoning_effort: str | None,
                   queue: asyncio.Queue, on_not_stored: Callable[[], Any] | None = None) -> None:
        def emit(name: str, data: dict) -> None:
            queue.put_nowait(Event(name, data))

        async def not_stored() -> None:
            if on_not_stored is not None:
                try:
                    await asyncio.to_thread(on_not_stored)
                except Exception:
                    log.exception("not-stored callback failed (conversation %s)", conversation_id)

        # The conversation lock first, then the user's own limit, then a server-wide slot: a
        # second message of a busy conversation waits without taking a slot. Every refusal comes
        # before anything is stored.
        try:
            async with self._locks.hold_async(conversation_id, timeout=self.lock_timeout):
                with self._user_turn(user_id):
                    async with self.slots.hold():
                        await self._turn(user_id, conversation_id, text, reasoning_effort, emit)
        except ConversationBusy:
            emit("error", {"code": "conversation_busy", "message": BUSY})
        except _UserBusy:
            log.warning("chat turn refused: user already has %d turns running (conversation %s)",
                        self.slots.config.max_turns_per_user, conversation_id)
            emit("error", {"code": "conversation_busy", "message": USER_BUSY})
        except ServerBusy:
            log.warning("chat turn refused: %d turns running, none ended within %gs (conversation %s)",
                        self.slots.active, self.slots.config.queue_seconds, conversation_id)
            await not_stored()
            emit("error", {"code": "server_busy", "message": SERVER_BUSY})
        except _NotStored:
            log.exception("chat turn: the user's message could not be stored (conversation %s)", conversation_id)
            await not_stored()
            emit("error", {"code": "internal_error", "message": NOT_STORED})
        except Exception:
            log.exception("chat turn failed (conversation %s)", conversation_id)
            emit("error", {"code": "internal_error", "message": INTERNAL})
        finally:
            queue.put_nowait(None)

    @contextmanager
    def _user_turn(self, user_id: str) -> Iterator[None]:
        """At most `max_turns_per_user` running turns per user (06 review P2-8). Event loop only."""
        if self._user_turns.get(user_id, 0) >= self.slots.config.max_turns_per_user:
            raise _UserBusy()
        self._user_turns[user_id] = self._user_turns.get(user_id, 0) + 1
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            self._user_turns[user_id] -= 1
            if not self._user_turns[user_id]:
                del self._user_turns[user_id]

    async def _turn(self, user_id: str, conversation_id: str, text: str, reasoning_effort: str | None,
                    emit: Callable[[str, dict], None]) -> None:
        store = self.store
        conversation = await asyncio.to_thread(store.get_conversation, user_id, conversation_id)
        try:
            user_message = await asyncio.to_thread(store.add_message, user_id, conversation_id, "user", text)
        except Exception as exc:  # app.db timeout, the conversation gone: nothing of the turn exists
            raise _NotStored() from exc
        emit("user_message", message_view(user_message))
        if conversation is not None and not conversation["title"]:
            await asyncio.to_thread(store.set_conversation_title, user_id, conversation_id,
                                    " ".join(text.split())[:TITLE_CHARS])

        context = await asyncio.to_thread(build_context, store, user_id, conversation_id)
        index = await asyncio.to_thread(self._city_index)
        today = store.clock().date()
        guard = ReplyGuard(index, records=context.records, user_text=text,
                           earlier_user_texts=context.user_texts[:-1], today=today)
        turn = _Turn(user_id, conversation_id, user_message, guard, emit, BudgetTracker(self.budget),
                     reasoning_effort)
        turn.messages = messages = [{"role": "system", "content": system_prompt(today)}, *context.messages]

        self._running[conversation_id] = turn
        try:
            try:
                try:
                    async with asyncio.timeout(self.turn_timeout):
                        turn.steps_task = asyncio.ensure_future(self._steps(turn, messages))
                        fallback = await turn.steps_task
                finally:
                    await self._drain(turn)
            except asyncio.CancelledError:
                task = asyncio.current_task()
                if not turn.cancelled or (task is not None and task.cancelling()):
                    raise  # shutdown, not `cancel()`
                fallback = [{"kind": "cancelled", "value": ""}]
            except TimeoutError:
                fallback = [{"kind": "turn_timeout", "value": str(self.turn_timeout)}]
            except LLMError as exc:
                fallback = [{"kind": "llm_error", "value": str(exc)[:200]}]
            except Exception as exc:  # a bug or a store error in the middle of the turn
                if not turn.outcomes and not turn.text:
                    raise
                log.exception("chat turn failed after producing output (conversation %s)", conversation_id)
                fallback = [{"kind": "internal_error", "value": type(exc).__name__}]
        finally:
            if self._running.get(conversation_id) is turn:
                del self._running[conversation_id]
        if fallback is not None and fallback[0]["kind"] in ("max_steps", "token_budget", "tool_budget"):
            log.warning("chat turn stopped by its budget (conversation %s): %s %s", conversation_id,
                        fallback[0]["kind"], turn.budget.snapshot())
        if fallback is not None and fallback[0]["kind"] in ("llm_error", "turn_timeout") \
                and not turn.outcomes and not turn.text:
            emit("error", {"code": "llm_unavailable", "message": LLM_UNAVAILABLE})
            return
        await self._finish(turn, fallback)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ the steps ----------
    async def _steps(self, turn: _Turn, messages: list[dict]) -> list[dict] | None:
        """The LLM / tool steps of a turn. Returns None when the LLM's text can stay, otherwise
        the problems that make the template reply replace it.

        One Pydantic AI run drives the steps: it streams each LLM call and dispatches its tool
        calls (one at a time, in call order, see `_sdk_tools`). `messages` is our copy of the
        context in the OpenAI shape (estimates, llm_calls records); a failed LLM call that is
        retried restarts the run from it.

        Budgets (design §4.8): a step starts only while steps and tokens are left; each tool call
        runs only while calls are left for the step and the turn. A call that is not admitted is
        never executed: it gets a `tool_budget_exceeded` result (stored like any tool call, so
        every tool call of the completion has its result and the stored history stays well-formed).
        Once the turn's calls are used up and a call was refused, the turn ends with the template."""
        attempt = 0
        while True:
            try:
                return await self._run_steps(turn, messages, attempt)
            except _RetryStep:
                attempt += 1

    async def _run_steps(self, turn: _Turn, messages: list[dict], attempt: int) -> list[dict] | None:
        settings = self.llm.settings(turn.reasoning_effort)
        async with self._runtime.iter(None, message_history=to_model_messages(messages), deps=turn,
                                      model_settings=settings) as run:
            async for node in run:
                if _Runtime.is_model_request_node(node):
                    if attempt == 0 and (stop := turn.budget.stop_before_step()) is not None:
                        return [stop]
                    try:
                        completion = await self._llm_step(turn, messages, run, node, attempt)
                    except _Stopped as stopped:  # guard failure, or no retry left within the token cap
                        return stopped.problems
                    attempt = 0
                    if not completion.tool_calls:
                        if completion.finish_reason != "stop":  # "length", "content_filter", ...
                            return [{"kind": "truncated", "value": str(completion.finish_reason)}]
                        if not turn.text.strip():
                            return [{"kind": "empty_reply", "value": ""}]
                        return None
                    if _flooded(completion, self.budget):
                        # far more calls than a step may run (06 review P2-3): none runs and none is
                        # stored one by one; the logged completion is marked so the next context skips it
                        refused = len(completion.tool_calls)
                        turn.budget.refused_calls += refused
                        log.warning("chat turn: a completion with %d tool calls; none run (conversation %s)",
                                    refused, turn.conversation_id)
                        return [{"kind": "tool_budget", "value": str(refused)}]
                    messages.append(completion.assistant_message())
                    turn.step_calls, turn.step_results, turn.step_logged = completion.tool_calls, {}, 0
                elif _Runtime.is_call_tools_node(node):
                    async with node.stream(run.ctx) as events:
                        async for event in events:
                            if isinstance(event, FunctionToolResultEvent) \
                                    and event.part.tool_call_id not in turn.step_results:
                                # a result our tools did not make: a name that is not one of our
                                # tools, refused by the SDK before any tool ran. It is answered and
                                # stored as before (`unknown_tool`, from Toolbox.run)
                                await self._tool_call(turn, event.part.tool_call_id, event.part.tool_name or "")
                    await self._log_tool_calls(turn, final=True)
                    for call in turn.step_calls:
                        outcome = turn.step_results[call["id"]]
                        messages.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": call["id"], "content": outcome.for_llm()})
                    if turn.exhausted:
                        return [{"kind": "tool_budget", "value": str(self.budget.max_tool_calls_per_turn)}]
                elif _Runtime.is_end_node(node):  # not reached: a step without tool calls returns above
                    return None
        return None  # pragma: no cover

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ tools --------------
    def _sdk_tools(self) -> list[Tool]:
        """The four tools as SDK tools over our own schemas and `Toolbox` (validation, structured
        errors). Sequential: one call at a time, in the order the model made them, so the budget
        admits them in order and the cards keep that order. `strict` off: the request carries the
        schemas exactly as before."""
        tools = []
        for schema in TOOL_SCHEMAS:
            name = schema["function"]["name"]

            async def run(ctx: RunContext[_Turn], _name: str = name, **_args: Any) -> str:
                return (await self._tool_call(ctx.deps, ctx.tool_call_id or "", _name)).for_llm()

            tool = Tool.from_schema(run, name=name, description=schema["function"]["description"],
                                    json_schema=schema["function"]["parameters"], takes_ctx=True, sequential=True)
            tool.strict = False
            tools.append(tool)
        return tools

    async def _tool_call(self, turn: _Turn, call_id: str, name: str) -> Outcome:
        """Admit, run and record one tool call of the current step. The arguments are the model's
        raw string (from the completion), validated by `Toolbox.run`. The blocking work runs in a
        tracked worker thread: if the turn is cancelled meanwhile the thread still ends, and the
        turn waits for it (`_drain`) before it releases its lock."""
        call = next((c for c in turn.step_calls if c["id"] == call_id),
                    {"id": call_id, "name": name, "arguments": ""})
        refused = turn.budget.admit_tool_call()
        if refused is None:
            turn.emit("status", {"text": STATUS_TEXT.get(call["name"], DEFAULT_STATUS)})
            outcome = await turn.threads.run(self._tools.run, turn.user_id, turn.conversation_id,
                                             call["name"], call["arguments"])
        else:
            turn.exhausted = turn.exhausted or refused == "per_turn"
            payload = refusal(refused, self.budget)
            outcome = Outcome(call["name"], str(call["arguments"])[:MAX_RAW_ARGUMENTS], payload["code"], payload,
                              error=f"budget: {refused}")
        # The outcome and its cards belong to the turn as soon as the tool returned, before
        # the row is written: if the time limit lands on the write, the reply still
        # carries the card that the stored row (written while draining) describes (P2-5).
        turn.outcomes.append(outcome)
        if refused is None:  # a refusal is no record a reply may quote
            turn.guard.add_record(outcome.payload)
        for card in outcome.cards:
            turn.cards.append(card)
            turn.emit("card", {"card": card})
        turn.step_results[call_id] = outcome
        await self._log_tool_calls(turn)
        return outcome

    async def _log_tool_calls(self, turn: _Turn, *, final: bool = False) -> None:
        """Store the tool_calls rows of the step in call order (context.py lines them up with
        the completion), each as soon as it and every call before it have their outcome."""
        while turn.step_logged < len(turn.step_calls):
            outcome = turn.step_results.get(turn.step_calls[turn.step_logged]["id"])
            if outcome is None:
                if not final:
                    return
                raise RuntimeError("a tool call of the step got no result")
            turn.step_logged += 1
            await turn.threads.run(
                self.store.add_tool_call, turn.user_id, turn.user_message["id"], outcome.name,
                outcome.args, outcome.payload, error=outcome.error, latency_ms=outcome.latency_ms)

    async def _drain(self, turn: _Turn) -> None:
        """Wait for worker threads the time limit (or an error) left running. A thread cannot be
        stopped; until it ends it may still write (a quote, a tool call row), so the reply is not
        stored and the conversation lock and the slot are not released before it ends - unless it
        outlives `drain_timeout` (store timeouts make that unlikely), which is logged."""
        if not turn.threads.running:
            return
        log.warning("chat turn cut short with %d worker thread(s) running; waiting up to %gs (conversation %s)",
                    turn.threads.running, self.drain_timeout, turn.conversation_id)
        if not await turn.threads.drain(self.drain_timeout):
            log.error("chat turn: %d worker thread(s) still running after %gs; ending the turn anyway "
                      "(conversation %s)", turn.threads.running, self.drain_timeout, turn.conversation_id)

    async def _finish(self, turn: _Turn, fallback: list[dict] | None = None) -> None:
        """Persist the assistant message (the `done` moment: quote cards become bookable)."""
        text = turn.text.rstrip()
        if fallback is not None:
            text = fallback_reply(turn.outcomes)
            turn.emit("replace", {"text": text})
        elif CLICK_TO_BOOK not in text and any(
                o.name == "request_booking" and o.code == "ok" for o in turn.outcomes):
            # fixed by code, whatever the LLM wrote: the click is what books
            piece = ("\n\n" if text else "") + CLICK_TO_BOOK
            turn.emit("delta", {"text": piece})
            text += piece
        message = await asyncio.to_thread(
            self._post_assistant_message, turn.user_id, turn.conversation_id, text, turn.cards, fallback)
        turn.emit("done", {"message": message})

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ LLM step -----------
    def _release(self, turn: _Turn, piece: str, first_of_step: bool) -> None:
        """Check the reply so far plus `piece`; send `piece` when nothing is wrong. Checking the
        whole text catches a number or a city name that spans two pieces (`St. | Louis`)."""
        if not turn.text:
            piece = piece.lstrip()
        elif first_of_step and not turn.text[-1].isspace() and not piece[:1].isspace():
            piece = "\n\n" + piece  # text of a later step starts a new paragraph
        problems = turn.guard.check(turn.text + piece)
        if problems:
            raise _GuardFailed(problems)
        turn.text += piece
        turn.emit("delta", {"text": piece})

    async def _llm_step(self, turn: _Turn, messages: list[dict], run: Any, node: Any, attempt: int) -> Completion:
        """One LLM call (one attempt). Text is released as it streams. A failed call is logged
        and charged; it is retried (`_RetryStep`, after the backoff) only while none of its text
        has been released, retries are left and the turn still has tokens."""
        request = {"turn": turn.user_message["id"], "messages": list(messages),
                   "tools": [t["function"]["name"] for t in TOOL_SCHEMAS],
                   "reasoning_effort": self.llm.effort(turn.reasoning_effort)}
        started = time.monotonic()
        buffer = SentenceBuffer()
        think = ThinkSplitter()  # an inline <think> block (servers without reasoning_content)
        thought = ""
        released = False
        content = blank = ""
        received: int | None = None  # output characters, once any output arrived

        def log_call(response: dict, usage: Any = None, *, output_chars: int | None = None,
                     no_response: bool = False) -> asyncio.Future:
            # every attempt counts against the turn's tokens, also failed ones and retries
            charged, estimated = turn.budget.charge(usage, messages, output_chars=output_chars,
                                                    no_response=no_response)
            response = {**response, "budget": {"charged_tokens": charged, "estimated": estimated,
                                               "turn_tokens": turn.budget.tokens}}
            # `tokens` = what the turn was charged, so the site's daily budget (§8.2) counts
            # estimated calls the same way (06 review P2-9); `response.usage` keeps the report
            return turn.threads.start(
                self.store.add_llm_call, turn.user_id, turn.conversation_id, request, response,
                latency_ms=int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000), tokens=charged,
                model=getattr(self.llm, "model", None))

        def got(n: int) -> None:
            nonlocal received
            received = (received or 0) + n

        def show(text: str) -> None:
            """Visible text: released sentence by sentence through the guard."""
            nonlocal content, blank, released
            content += text
            for sentence in buffer.push(text):
                if sentence.strip():
                    self._release(turn, blank + sentence, not released)
                    blank, released = "", True
                else:
                    blank += sentence  # white space is never sent on its own

        try:
            # the per-call time limit; leaving the block (a guard failure, the limit, a
            # cancellation) closes the model's HTTP stream right away
            async with asyncio.timeout(self.llm_timeout):
                async with node.stream(run.ctx) as stream:
                    async for event in stream:
                        text = ""
                        if isinstance(event, PartStartEvent):
                            part = event.part
                            if isinstance(part, TextPart):
                                text = part.content
                            elif isinstance(part, ThinkingPart):
                                got(len(part.content))
                            elif isinstance(part, ToolCallPart):
                                got(len(part.tool_name) + len(part.args_as_json_str() if part.args else ""))
                        elif isinstance(event, PartDeltaEvent):
                            delta = event.delta
                            if isinstance(delta, TextPartDelta):
                                text = delta.content_delta
                            elif isinstance(delta, ThinkingPartDelta):
                                got(len(delta.content_delta or ""))
                            elif isinstance(delta, ToolCallPartDelta):
                                args = delta.args_delta
                                got(len(delta.tool_name_delta or "")
                                    + len(args if isinstance(args, str) else json.dumps(args or {})))
                        if not text:
                            continue
                        got(len(text))
                        text, inline = think.feed(text)
                        thought += inline
                        show(text)
                    response = stream.response
                text, inline = think.finish()
                thought += inline
                show(text)
                completion = Completion.from_response(response, content)
                completion.reasoning += thought
                if completion.finish_reason is None:  # the stream ended early (no finish reason)
                    raise LLMError("LLM stream ended without a finish_reason", retryable=True,
                                   received=completion.output_chars, usage=completion.usage)
                rest = buffer.flush()
                if rest.strip():
                    self._release(turn, blank + rest, not released)
        except _GuardFailed as failed:
            # the stream was cut by us; how much (hidden) output it produced is unknown
            await asyncio.shield(log_call({"content": content, "guard_problems": failed.problems,
                                           "aborted": True}))
            raise
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            # the turn's time limit, a cancellation or shutdown interrupted this call: it is still
            # recorded and charged (06 review P2-4); `_drain` waits for the record to be written
            log_call({"content": content, "aborted": "cancelled" if turn.cancelled else "turn_timeout"})
            raise
        except (LLMError, TimeoutError, ModelAPIError, UnexpectedModelBehavior) as exc:
            if isinstance(exc, TimeoutError):  # this call's own time limit: output unknown
                error, usage, received = LLMError("LLM call timed out", retryable=True), None, None
            else:
                error = llm_error(exc, received=received, scrub=self.llm.config.api_key)
                usage = error.usage
                received = error.received if error.received is not None else (len(content) or None)
            await asyncio.shield(log_call(
                {"content": content, "error": str(error)[:300], "attempt": attempt + 1}, usage,
                output_chars=received, no_response=not isinstance(exc, TimeoutError) and received is None))
            if released or not error.retryable or attempt == self.retries:
                raise error from None
            if (stop := turn.budget.out_of_tokens()) is not None:
                raise _Stopped([stop]) from None  # no retry past the token cap (P2-2)
            await self._sleep(self.backoff * 2 ** attempt)
            raise _RetryStep() from None
        record = completion.as_record()
        if _flooded(completion, self.budget):
            record["tool_calls_not_run"] = True  # build_context skips this completion
        await asyncio.shield(log_call(record, completion.usage, output_chars=completion.output_chars))
        return completion

    def _city_index(self) -> CityIndex:
        """City names for the guard, from the airline's current network (rebuilt when
        locations.db changes)."""
        net = self._networks.current()
        if self._index is None or self._index[0] != net.fingerprint.id:
            self._index = (net.fingerprint.id, CityIndex(net.cities))
        return self._index[1]


def _flooded(completion: Completion, budget: AgentBudget) -> bool:
    """More tool calls in one completion than any honest step needs (P2-3)."""
    return len(completion.tool_calls) > budget.max_tool_calls_per_step * FLOOD_FACTOR

1	"""Offline fake LLMs (tests, the evals' CI mode, the benchmark): a scripted generator behind a
2	fake OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint.
3	
4	A subclass writes `async def stream(messages, tools, *, reasoning_effort)` and yields `TextDelta`s
5	and one `Completion`, or raises `LLMError`, exactly as the scripts did before ADR-001. `ScriptedLLM`
6	serves it as chat-completions SSE through an httpx2 mock transport, so the turn runs through the
7	real Pydantic AI `OpenAIChatModel` (request body, chunk parsing, tool-call assembly, finish reason,
8	usage), and the script sees the request as it would reach the provider:
9	- `messages`, `tools`: the wire JSON of the request;
10	- `reasoning_effort`: read back from the request's thinking fields ("none" / the level / None).
11	Failures are played as the wire would show them: an `LLMError` with a `status` before any output is
12	that HTTP status; an `LLMError` without one is a connection error (with `received=n`, n characters
13	of reasoning are streamed first, then the stream is cut); an `LLMError` after output cuts the stream
14	(read error). Any other exception is raised as it is (a bug, not a provider failure).
15	A script that ends without a `Completion` ends the stream without a finish reason.
16	"""
17	from __future__ import annotations
18	
19	import json
20	from dataclasses import dataclass
21	from typing import Any, AsyncIterator
22	
23	import httpx2
24	
25	from .config import LLMConfig
26	from .model import ChatModel, Completion, LLMError
27	
28	__all__ = ["Completion", "LLMError", "ScriptedLLM", "TextDelta"]
29	
30	
31	@dataclass(frozen=True)
32	class TextDelta:
33	    text: str
34	
35	
36	def _chunk(delta: dict, finish: str | None = None, usage: dict | None = None) -> bytes:
37	    c: dict[str, Any] = {"id": "scripted", "object": "chat.completion.chunk", "created": 0, "model": "scripted",
38	                         "choices": [{"index": 0, "delta": delta, "finish_reason": finish}]}
39	    if usage is not None:
40	        c["usage"] = usage
41	    return f"data: {json.dumps(c, ensure_ascii=False)}\n\n".encode()
42	
43	
44	def _effort(body: dict) -> str | None:
45	    thinking = body.get("thinking")
46	    if isinstance(thinking, dict) and thinking.get("type") == "disabled":
47	        return "none"
48	    return body.get("reasoning_effort")
49	
50	
51	class ScriptedLLM(ChatModel):
52	    model = "scripted-fake"
53	
54	    def __init__(self, *, reasoning_effort: str = "high"):
55	        config = LLMConfig(api_key="sk-scripted-not-a-key", base_url="http://scripted.invalid/v1", model=self.model,
56	                           reasoning_effort=reasoning_effort)
57	        super().__init__(config, transport=httpx2.MockTransport(self._handle))
58	        self.bodies: list[dict] = []  # every request body, as sent
59	        self.streams: list[str] = []  # per streamed response: "open", then "done" or "closed early"
60	
61	    def stream(self, messages: list[dict], tools: list[dict], *,
62	               reasoning_effort: str | None = None) -> AsyncIterator[Any]:
63	        """The script: yields TextDelta and one Completion, or raises LLMError."""
64	        raise NotImplementedError
65	
66	    async def _handle(self, request: httpx2.Request) -> httpx2.Response:
67	        body = json.loads(request.content)
68	        self.bodies.append(body)
69	        gen = self.stream(body.get("messages") or [], body.get("tools") or [], reasoning_effort=_effort(body))
70	        try:
71	            first = await anext(gen)
72	        except StopAsyncIteration:
73	            first = None
74	        except LLMError as exc:
75	            if exc.status is not None:
76	                return httpx2.Response(exc.status)  # no body: the error is the status
77	            if exc.received:
78	                return self._stream(None, gen, failure=exc)
79	            raise httpx2.ConnectError(str(exc), request=request) from None
80	        except Exception:  # anything else (a bug) is raised as it is
81	            raise
82	        return self._stream(first, gen)
83	
84	    def _stream(self, first: Any, gen: AsyncIterator[Any], failure: LLMError | None = None) -> httpx2.Response:
85	        index = len(self.streams)
86	        self.streams.append("open")
87	
88	        async def body() -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
89	            try:
90	                async for data in lines():
91	                    yield data
92	                self.streams[index] = "done"
93	            finally:
94	                if self.streams[index] == "open":  # the client closed the response before its end
95	                    self.streams[index] = "closed early"
96	                await gen.aclose()
97	
98	        async def lines() -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
99	            yield _chunk({"role": "assistant", "content": ""})
100	            if failure is not None:
101	                yield _chunk({"reasoning_content": "x" * int(failure.received or 0)})
102	                raise httpx2.ReadError(str(failure))
103	            item = first
104	            while item is not None:
105	                if isinstance(item, TextDelta):
106	                    yield _chunk({"content": item.text})
107	                elif isinstance(item, Completion):
108	                    for data in _completion(item):
109	                        yield data
110	                try:
111	                    item = await anext(gen)
112	                except StopAsyncIteration:
113	                    break
114	                except LLMError as exc:  # a failure after output: the stream is cut
115	                    raise httpx2.ReadError(str(exc)) from None
116	            yield b"data: [DONE]\n\n"
117	
118	        return httpx2.Response(200, headers={"content-type": "text/event-stream"}, content=body())
119	
120	
121	def _completion(c: Completion) -> list[bytes]:
122	    out = []
123	    if c.reasoning:
124	        out.append(_chunk({"reasoning_content": c.reasoning}))
125	    for i, call in enumerate(c.tool_calls):
126	        out.append(_chunk({"tool_calls": [{"index": i, "id": call["id"], "type": "function",
127	                                           "function": {"name": call["name"], "arguments": call["arguments"]}}]}))
128	    if c.finish_reason is not None:
129	        out.append(_chunk({}, c.finish_reason))
130	    if c.usage is not None:
131	        out.append(_chunk({}, None, c.usage))
132	    return out

1	# ADR-001: Agent runtime — adopt Pydantic AI Slim
2	
3	- Status: **accepted** (2026-11-24, decided by the owner after both POCs)
4	- Issue: #49 · Roadmap: [docs/roadmap.md](../roadmap.md) · Evidence:
5	  [poc-pydantic-ai.md](../iterations/08-runtime/poc-pydantic-ai.md),
6	  [poc-openai-agents.md](../iterations/08-runtime/poc-openai-agents.md), code in `spikes/`
7	
8	## Context
9	The MVP runs a hand-written agent loop (`backend/app/agent/loop.py` + `llm.py`, an httpx client for the
10	OpenAI-compatible streaming protocol). Two next steps motivated a move to an agent SDK (owner, 2026-11-24):
11	a user **Stop** that cancels the backend run and the upstream model stream (#48), and **systematic tracing** through
12	OpenTelemetry to a local Phoenix (#35). Two candidates were tested on the real DeepSeek endpoint plus a fake
13	OpenAI-compatible server that records TCP close, with the same 15 checks.
14	
15	## Evidence
16	| | Own loop (today) | Pydantic AI Slim 2.71 | OpenAI Agents SDK 0.25 |
17	|---|---|---|---|
18	| Streaming, sequential + parallel tool calls on DeepSeek | yes | yes (set sequential tools, `strict` off) | yes |
19	| Cancel → upstream TCP closed (median) | 0.1 ms (`aclose`) | 1.6–1.8 ms fake server, 0.6 ms DeepSeek | 0.4 ms |
20	| New LLM requests / tools after cancel | 0 (no Stop path yet) | 0 | 0 |
21	| Waits for started sync work on cancel | our `Threads.drain` | no, keep `Threads` | no, keep `Threads` |
22	| ReplyGuard before text is streamed | yes | yes (`iter` + `node.stream`) | yes |
23	| Budgets (steps, tools per step / turn, token soft cap) | ours | timeout and per-call output built in; rest via our `budget.py` | steps and timeout built in; rest via hooks |
24	| Tracing | none | OpenTelemetry native; **no outbound export by default** | own span model; **remote export to OpenAI on by default**, must be replaced |
25	| Runtime deps (packages) | 22–23 | +16 | +23 |
26	| Install / image delta | — | +39 MB unpacked, +7 MB compressed | about +56 MB |
27	| Cold import | 0.10–0.17 s | +0.32 s | +0.45 s |
28	| `backend/app/agent` net LOC | 2237 | about −120 (−5%) | about −100 (−5%) |
29	| Real-model cost of the POC | — | about $0.03 | $0.0046 |
30	
31	First-token latency was within noise for all three.
32	
33	## Decision
34	Adopt **Pydantic AI Slim** (`pydantic-ai-slim[openai]`, pinned) for the generic runtime: the model client (HTTP
35	stream, chunk parsing, tool-call assembly, provider request fields, per-call retry / timeout), tool dispatch and run
36	cancellation. Its tracing is OpenTelemetry from the start, with no outbound export unless we configure an exporter.
37	That fits #35 directly. The dependency cost is the smaller of the two SDKs.
38	
39	Neither SDK met the plan's "clearly less code to maintain" rule: each removes about 5% net. The owner chose
40	adoption anyway, for standard cancellation and tracing semantics that a widely used runtime maintains. Without the
41	SDK, the same features would be hand-written and maintained here. The recommended alternative, keeping the own loop,
42	was considered and rejected on these grounds.
43	
44	## Boundaries — what stays our code
45	- **Booking:** no `book` tool. Tickets only from the user's click on a presented confirm card with a one-time nonce
46	  (`airline/`, B1–B7). `request_booking` only shows the card.
47	- **ReplyGuard** runs on buffered sentences before any text reaches the client; the SDK's output validators are not
48	  a substitute.
49	- **Tools:** `Tool.from_schema` over our `TOOL_SCHEMAS`; validation, structured errors and `Outcome` stay in
50	  `tools.py`. `user_id` / `conversation_id` come from trusted run deps, never from model arguments. Tools run
51	  **sequentially** and in call order, and their sync work goes through our `Threads` (drained before locks are
52	  released, C2).
53	- **History:** app.db history and compaction (`context.py`), converted to `message_history`. No SDK session store.
54	- **SSE contract** (`status`, `card`, `delta`, `replace`, `done`, `error`) is unchanged; SDK events are mapped to it.
55	- **Budgets and concurrency:** `budget.py`, turn slots, per-user caps, conversation locks, `llm_calls` records and the
56	  usage estimate when usage is missing (cancelled or cut streams).
57	- **Error mapping:** SDK exceptions (`ModelAPIError`, `UnexpectedModelBehavior`, timeouts, tool exceptions) map to
58	  today's fallbacks and templates. A stream that ends without `finish_reason` is not treated as `stop`.
59	
60	## Consequences
61	- `llm.py`'s httpx client and most of `_steps` / `_llm_step` are deleted. The test doubles (`FakeLLM`,
62	  `ScriptedLLM`) move onto `FunctionModel`. The loop and runtime-review tests are kept and must pass unchanged in
63	  intent.
64	- There are two HTTP stacks: `httpx` (Google JWKS) and `httpx2` (openai 3.x). Proxy settings come from the
65	  environment (`trust_env`).
66	- Fast-moving 2.x API: pin the version. Upgrades run the full test suite plus `spikes/pydantic-ai/poc/checks_fake.py`.
67	- Settings that must be explicit: sequential tool execution, `strict` off for our schemas, DeepSeek thinking fields
68	  via `extra_body` (same request as today), `PYDANTIC_AI_NO_BANNER=1`, and `iter` + `run.cancel()` rather than
69	  `run_stream`.
70	- #48 builds Stop on this runtime: an app-owned `run_id`, cancelling the run task, and `Threads` drain. #35 adds the
71	  OTLP exporter, business spans and the Phoenix profile on its OpenTelemetry spans.
72	- Rollback: the migration is one PR; reverting it restores the own loop.

1	# State invariants
2	
3	Booking and confirmation rules are checked by model-based tests: a small reference model plus seeded random event
4	sequences, every invariant asserted after every event. A new state bug gets a new rule id here first, then a test.
5	Design context: `docs/design/design.md` §6.
6	
7	## Event alphabet
8	`quote(user, conv, origin, dest)`, `stream_done(conv)` (cards presented, nonces issued),
9	`user_message(conv, text)` (incl. negations and questions), `llm_request_booking(conv, quote)`,
10	`click_book(user, quote, nonce)`, `click_book_concurrent(user, quote, nonce)`, `replay_nonce(quote, nonce)`,
11	`clock(+Δ)`, `db_change(kind)` (leg removed / coordinate moved / unrelated row changed / file replaced),
12	`other_user_click(quote, nonce)`, `disconnect_reconnect(conv)`.
13	
14	## B. Booking
15	- **B1 Ownership.** A ticket exists only if its quote belongs to the user who clicked.
16	- **B2 Presented.** A ticket exists only if its quote reached `presented` (its full card was sent with `done`) before the click.
17	- **B3 Click only.** Every ticket is caused by exactly one `click_book` with a valid, unused nonce for that quote; no
18	  other event (in particular `llm_request_booking`, any `user_message`) ever creates a ticket.
19	- **B4 Validity.** No ticket for a quote older than 15 minutes at click time.
20	- **B5 Idempotent.** At most one ticket per quote, under replay and concurrent clicks.
21	- **B6 Fresh.** A ticket's legs, coordinates, distance and price strings equal a fresh recomputation on the
22	  `locations.db` current at click time, and the route is still the cheapest; otherwise the quote is `stale` and no ticket.
23	- **B7 Atomic.** Quote status and tickets never disagree: `booked` ⇔ exactly one ticket.
24	
25	## Q. Quotes
26	- **Q1 No supersede.** Creating a quote never changes the status of another quote.
27	- **Q2 Button state.** The button state a client sees (after `done` or reconnect) equals the server's quote state.
28	- **Q3 Terminal.** `booked`, `expired`, `stale` never change again.
29	
30	## Process
31	- Seeds are fixed in CI. A failing seed prints its shrunk sequence and is kept as a named regression case.
32	- Layers: pure model test over `airline/` → API driven with fakes (clock, LLM, locations.db copy) → UI scenario
33	  (ego-browser) for the click path.
34	
35	## U. Usage limits
36	- **U1 Daily cap.** For every user and UTC day, messages let through ≤ `DAILY_MESSAGES_PER_USER`; counting and the
37	  reservation happen in one write transaction; a refused message stores nothing. (Model test:
38	  `test_reservations_match_a_reference_count`.) Known: the site token budget is checked at message start, so turns
39	  already running may overshoot it by their own cost; a `conversation_busy` message has already used its slot.
40	- **U2 One account per invite code.** An invite code maps to exactly one account, independent of the order of
41	  `INVITE_CODES`; the name is a display name only.
42	
43	## S. Sessions
44	- **S1 Revocable sessions.** A session is valid only while its epoch equals `users.session_epoch` and its login method
45	  is still enabled; logout bumps the epoch (all of the user's sessions end).
46	
47	## C. Concurrency
48	- **C1 Site-wide slots.** At most `AGENT_MAX_ACTIVE_TURNS` turns hold a slot; a refused turn (`server_busy`) stores
49	  nothing and refunds its message slot. (Model test: `test_slots_model`.)
50	- **C2 Drain before release.** A turn releases its conversation lock and slot only after every worker thread it started
51	  has ended, or after the drain timeout (30 s, logged).
52	- **C3 Clicks hold no worker thread while waiting.** A booking click waits for the conversation lock on the event
53	  loop; its transaction runs to its end before the lock is released, even when the request is cancelled.
54	- **C4 Per-user caps.** At most `AGENT_MAX_TURNS_PER_USER` turns and 2 pending booking clicks per user at once.

26	## 做了什么
27	
28	| ADR 边界 | 实现 |
29	|---|---|
30	| SDK 管模型客户端（HTTP 流、chunk 解析、tool-call 拼装、请求字段） | `model.py` 的 `ChatModel`：`OpenAIChatModel` + `DeepSeekProvider`（所有 base URL 都用 DeepSeek 方言，即旧客户端的请求格式），httpx2 客户端，超时同旧值。`llm.py` 删除 |
31	| SDK 管工具分发 | `loop.py` 用 `Agent.iter` + `node.stream` 驱动；四个工具 `Tool.from_schema(TOOL_SCHEMAS[...])`，`sequential=True`、`strict=False`，执行体仍是 `Toolbox.run`；`user_id` / `conversation_id` 来自 `deps`（`_Turn`） |
32	| SDK 管取消 | `Agent.cancel(user_id, conversation_id)`：取消本轮的 steps 任务 → SDK 关上游流、不再开始新请求和工具；已开始的工具线程走 `Threads`，drain 后才落库、放锁。不做 run_id / Stop 接口 / 前端（#48） |
33	| Tracing | 默认不装 `Instrumentation`，无 exporter、无 logfire；`Agent(tracer_provider=...)` 是给 #35 的入口（`include_content=False`） |
34	| ReplyGuard 在输出前 | 文本事件 → `SentenceBuffer` → `ReplyGuard` → `delta`，不变；guard 失败直接离开流，上游即关 |
35	| app.db 历史 | `build_context`（不变）→ `to_model_messages()` → `message_history` |
36	| SSE 契约 | 不变；契约 fixture 测试通过 |
37	| 预算、并发、锁、drain、llm_calls、缺 usage 的估算 | 全部沿用，语义不变（`budget.py`、`concurrency.py` 未改） |
38	| 异常映射 | `llm_error()`：`ModelHTTPError` → 按状态码判断可否重试；`ModelAPIError` / `UnexpectedModelBehavior` → 可重试；其他异常（bug）照旧走 `internal_error` |
39	| 无 finish_reason 不当 stop | 读 `provider_details["finish_reason"]`，为空 → `LLMError("LLM stream ended without a finish_reason")`，与旧行为相同 |
40	| `strict` 关、thinking 字段同旧、无 banner | `tool.strict = False`；thinking 走 `extra_body`（`{"thinking": {"type": ...}, "reasoning_effort": ...}`）；`PYDANTIC_AI_NO_BANNER=1`（代码 + Dockerfile） |
41	
42	### 与 ADR 预期不同、需要协调者知道的地方
43	1. **重试仍是我们的。** ADR 写"per-call retry 由 SDK 负责"。实测 SDK 只在流输出到达消费者之前重试，而旧语义是"还没有
44	   放出文字就重试"（缓冲中的 `Hel` 仍可重试），且每次尝试都要落 `llm_calls`、计费、重试前查 token 上限。所以 openai 客户端
45	   `max_retries=0`，失败的那一步从我们的上下文重新开一个 `iter` 再试（`_RetryStep`）。测试意图全部保留。
46	2. **请求上下文仍以我们的为准。** 用 `before_model_request` 能力（`_WireContext`）把每次请求的消息换成 loop 自己的上下文
47	   （`turn.messages`）。原因：SDK 自己的历史会把坏的工具名（`weird tool!`）原样发回（review #11 修过的问题），把未知工具的
48	   结果写成它自己的文字，`[booking event]` 这类会话中途的 system 消息会被改成 user 消息里的 `<system>` 块，还会在前面加
49	   约 120 词的说明。现在线上请求与迁移前一致（只多一处：用户文字里出现 `<system>` 一类标签时，SDK 会在前面加一条提示）。
50	3. **两个工具边界情况靠 hook。** 参数不是 JSON 对象 → `before_tool_validate`（`_RawArguments`）把原串交给 `Toolbox.run`，仍回
51	   `invalid_arguments`；未知工具名 → SDK 先拒，loop 从结果事件补记 `unknown_tool`（准入、落 `tool_calls`、回给模型的是我们的 JSON）。
52	4. **`<think>` 内联拆分保留。** SDK 只认单独成块的 `<think>` 标签；整段在同一个 chunk 里时会当成正文（guard 会拦下，但回复变模板）。
53	   旧的 `ThinkSplitter` 移到 `model.py` 继续用。
54	5. **代码量没有减少。** `backend/app/agent` 2237 → 2589 行（+352），其中 132 行是测试 / evals / bench 共用的离线假模型
55	   （`scripted.py`，旧的假模型分散在测试里）。不算它是 +220。POC 估计 −120，差别来自上面 1–4 条：重试重开、上下文替换、两个 hook、
56	   未知工具补记、工具结果按调用顺序落库、取消接口。按文件：`llm.py` −282；`model.py` +296；`loop.py` 495 → 699；

97	- **被拒调用不执行**：`admit_tool_call` 是唯一入口，拒绝分支不碰 `Toolbox`；每个 `tool_call_id` 都有结果，落库行数与 completion 对齐，`build_context` 能重建。
98	- **停止不出票**：agent 只持有 4 个工具和 `post_assistant_message`；超时 / 预算 / LLM 错误后已推送的卡片照常 `presented`，出票仍只能由点击触发。
99	- **不良构会话**：时限打断在一步中间时，`context.steps()` 行数对不上会退回 “每个调用一条 assistant 消息”，协议仍有效。
100	- **TurnSlots**：FIFO 交接、超时与交接同时发生（保留名额）、等待者被取消（归还名额）都没有泄漏；锁 → 名额顺序固定，订票只拿锁，没有环。
101	- **server_busy 退还**：只在 `_run` 里调用一次，按预留 id 删除，重复调用和跨 UTC 日都无副作用；客户端断开也会执行。
102	- **客户端断开**：轮次在自己的任务里跑完并落库，锁和名额在 drain 之后释放。
103	- **app.db 超时**：`write()` 遇 “locked / interrupted” 整体回滚（含 SQLite 自动回滚的情况），事务内没有吞掉 sqlite 异常的代码；
104	  出票 503 后 quote 仍 `presented`，同一 nonce 可再用。

4	Pydantic AI owns the HTTP stream, chunk parsing, tool-call assembly and inline `<think>` blocks.
5	Ours, here:

44	@dataclass
45	class Completion:
46	    content: str = ""
47	    tool_calls: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)  # [{"id", "name", "arguments": str}]
48	    finish_reason: str | None = None
49	    usage: dict | None = None
50	    reasoning: str = ""
51	
52	    def assistant_message(self) -> dict:
53	        """The message the context gets for this call (tool calls in their wire-safe form)."""
54	        message: dict[str, Any] = {"role": "assistant", "content": self.content or ""}
55	        if self.reasoning:
56	            message["reasoning_content"] = self.reasoning
57	        if self.tool_calls:
58	            message["tool_calls"] = [wire_tool_call(c["id"], c["name"], c["arguments"]) for c in self.tool_calls]
59	        return message
60	
61	    def as_record(self) -> dict:
62	        """What is stored in llm_calls: the reasoning is kept verbatim for provenance and to pass
63	        it back in later requests; it is never shown to the user and never guarded as reply text."""
64	        return {"content": self.content, "reasoning_content": self.reasoning,
65	                "tool_calls": self.tool_calls, "finish_reason": self.finish_reason, "usage": self.usage}
66	
67	    @property
68	    def output_chars(self) -> int:
69	        """Characters the model produced: text, reasoning, tool call names and arguments."""
70	        return len(self.content) + len(self.reasoning) + sum(
71	            len(str(c.get("name") or "")) + len(str(c.get("arguments") or "")) for c in self.tool_calls)

73	    @classmethod
74	    def from_response(cls, response: ModelResponse, content: str) -> "Completion":
75	        """`content`: the visible text as streamed (the response's text parts joined). The raw
76	        `finish_reason` is the provider's (None when the stream ended without one: Pydantic AI
77	        reports that as "stop", we do not)."""
78	        reasoning = "".join(p.content for p in response.parts if isinstance(p, ThinkingPart))
79	        calls = [{"id": p.tool_call_id or f"call_{i}", "name": p.tool_name,
80	                  "arguments": p.args if isinstance(p.args, str) else json.dumps(p.args or {}, ensure_ascii=False)}
81	                 for i, p in enumerate(response.parts) if isinstance(p, ToolCallPart)]
82	        finish = (response.provider_details or {}).get("finish_reason")
83	        return cls(content, calls, finish, usage_dict(response), reasoning)

86	def usage_dict(response: ModelResponse) -> dict | None:
87	    """The provider's usage in its own wire shape (what llm_calls stored before ADR-001; budget.py
88	    and the evals' cost read it): prompt / completion / total tokens, DeepSeek's cache hit / miss
89	    counts, cached and reasoning token details. None when nothing was reported."""
90	    u = response.usage
91	    if not (u.input_tokens or u.output_tokens):
92	        return None
93	    out: dict[str, Any] = {"prompt_tokens": u.input_tokens, "completion_tokens": u.output_tokens,
94	                           "total_tokens": u.input_tokens + u.output_tokens}
95	    details = dict(u.details or {})
96	    for key in ("prompt_cache_hit_tokens", "prompt_cache_miss_tokens"):
97	        if key in details:
98	            out[key] = details[key]
99	    if u.cache_read_tokens:
100	        out["prompt_tokens_details"] = {"cached_tokens": u.cache_read_tokens}
101	    if "reasoning_tokens" in details:
102	        out["completion_tokens_details"] = {"reasoning_tokens": details["reasoning_tokens"]}
103	    return out

106	_TOOL_NAME = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$")
107	INVALID_TOOL_NAME = "invalid_tool"

110	def wire_tool_call(call_id: str, name: str, arguments: Any) -> dict:
111	    """A tool call as it is sent back to the LLM. A name the API may reject (OpenAI:
112	    `^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$`) becomes `invalid_tool`, and arguments that are not a JSON object
113	    become `{}`, so one broken call cannot make every later request of the conversation fail.
114	    The raw values stay in `tool_calls` (app.db) and in the tool result's error."""
115	    if not isinstance(name, str) or not _TOOL_NAME.match(name):
116	        name = INVALID_TOOL_NAME
117	    if not isinstance(arguments, str):
118	        arguments = json.dumps(arguments, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
119	    try:
120	        ok = isinstance(json.loads(arguments), dict)
121	    except (ValueError, RecursionError):
122	        ok = False
123	    return {"id": call_id, "type": "function",
124	            "function": {"name": name, "arguments": arguments if ok else "{}"}}

127	class ThinkSplitter:
128	    """Moves a `<think>...</think>` block at the start of `content` (servers that inline the
129	    reasoning instead of using `reasoning_content`) out of the visible text."""
130	
131	    OPEN, CLOSE = "<think>", "</think>"
132	
133	    def __init__(self) -> None:
134	        self.state = "start"  # start -> think -> text
135	        self.buf = ""
136	
137	    def feed(self, text: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
138	        """(visible text, reasoning text) for this chunk."""
139	        if self.state == "text":
140	            return text, ""
141	        if self.state == "lead":  # white space right after </think> is dropped
142	            text = text.lstrip()
143	            if text:
144	                self.state = "text"
145	            return text, ""
146	        self.buf += text
147	        if self.state == "start":
148	            head = self.buf.lstrip()
149	            if self.OPEN.startswith(head):  # may still become "<think>"
150	                return "", ""
151	            if not head.startswith(self.OPEN):
152	                self.state, out, self.buf = "text", self.buf, ""
153	                return out, ""
154	            self.state, self.buf = "think", head[len(self.OPEN):]
155	        end = self.buf.find(self.CLOSE)
156	        if end < 0:  # keep a possible partial "</think>" at the end
157	            keep = max((k for k in range(1, len(self.CLOSE)) if self.buf.endswith(self.CLOSE[:k])), default=0)
158	            reasoning, self.buf = self.buf[:len(self.buf) - keep], self.buf[len(self.buf) - keep:]
159	            return "", reasoning
160	        reasoning, rest = self.buf[:end], self.buf[end + len(self.CLOSE):].lstrip()
161	        self.state, self.buf = ("text" if rest else "lead"), ""
162	        return rest, reasoning
163	
164	    def finish(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
165	        rest, self.buf = self.buf, ""
166	        if self.state == "think":
167	            return "", rest
168	        return rest, ""

172	class LLMError(Exception):
173	    """A failed LLM call. `received` says what it may have cost (06 review P1-2): None when no
174	    response body was read (HTTP error status, connection / TLS failure, timeout before the
175	    response): the provider generated nothing. Otherwise the number of output characters
176	    (text, reasoning, tool call names and arguments) received before the stream broke. `usage`:
177	    the usage block, if the provider sent one before the failure."""
178	
179	    def __init__(self, message: str, *, retryable: bool, status: int | None = None,
180	                 received: int | None = None, usage: dict | None = None):
181	        super().__init__(message)
182	        self.retryable = retryable
183	        self.status = status
184	        self.received = received
185	        self.usage = usage
186	
187	
188	def llm_error(exc: BaseException, *, received: int | None, scrub: str = "") -> LLMError:
189	    """An SDK / transport failure as an LLMError. `received`: output characters seen in this
190	    attempt, None when no output event arrived. HTTP errors read no body (received None); the
191	    body is quoted except for 401/403 (it may quote the key) and never contains `scrub`."""
192	    if isinstance(exc, LLMError):
193	        return exc
194	    if isinstance(exc, ModelHTTPError):
195	        status = exc.status_code
196	        detail = ""
197	        if status not in (401, 403) and exc.body:
198	            body = exc.body if isinstance(exc.body, str) else json.dumps(exc.body, default=str)
199	            detail = ": " + (body.replace(scrub, "***") if scrub else body)[:300]
200	        return LLMError(f"LLM HTTP {status}{detail}", status=status,
201	                        retryable=status in (408, 409, 429) or status >= 500)
202	    if isinstance(exc, ModelAPIError):  # connection errors, timeouts, cut streams
203	        return LLMError(f"LLM transport error: {type(exc).__name__}", retryable=True, received=received)
204	    if isinstance(exc, UnexpectedModelBehavior):  # a chunk or response of an unexpected shape
205	        return LLMError(f"LLM stream could not be read: {type(exc).__name__}", retryable=True, received=received)
206	    return LLMError(f"LLM stream could not be read: {type(exc).__name__}", retryable=True, received=received)

210	class ChatModel:
211	    """One instance per event loop (it keeps an HTTP client); `await aclose()` at shutdown.
212	    `transport`: an httpx2 transport for tests (the scripted fakes in `scripted.py`)."""
213	
214	    def __init__(self, config: LLMConfig, *, transport: httpx2.AsyncBaseTransport | None = None,
215	                 timeout: httpx2.Timeout | None = None, temperature: float = 0,
216	                 max_tokens: int = MAX_TOKENS, provider: str | None = None):
217	        """`provider`: the request dialect, "deepseek" (default, for every base URL: the dialect the
218	        hand-written client spoke before ADR-001 - `max_tokens`, `reasoning_content` passed back as a
219	        field) or "openai" (`max_completion_tokens`, reasoning passed back inline)."""
220	        self.config = config
221	        self.model = config.model  # the name, as llm_calls stores it
222	        self.reasoning_effort = config.reasoning_effort
223	        self.temperature = temperature
224	        self.max_tokens = max_tokens
225	        # trust_env: proxies from the environment, as before
226	        self._http = httpx2.AsyncClient(transport=transport, timeout=timeout or DEFAULT_TIMEOUT)
227	        provider_kwargs = {"api_key": config.api_key, "base_url": config.base_url, "http_client": self._http}
228	        if provider not in (None, "deepseek", "openai"):
229	            raise ValueError(f"unknown provider dialect {provider!r}")
230	        deepseek = provider != "openai"
231	        provider = DeepSeekProvider(**provider_kwargs) if deepseek else OpenAIProvider(**provider_kwargs)
232	        # our context has mid-conversation system messages ([booking event], [earlier turns
233	        # omitted]); they go on the wire as system messages, as before, not as <system> blocks
234	        # inside user turns with an announcement prepended (the SDK's default for this dialect)
235	        profile = merge_profile(provider.model_profile(config.model), ModelProfile(supports_inline_system_prompts=True))
236	        self.chat = OpenAIChatModel(config.model, provider=provider, profile=profile)
237	
238	    def settings(self, reasoning_effort: str | None = None) -> ModelSettings:
239	        """The request settings of one call: today's body fields (llm.py before ADR-001)."""
240	        if reasoning_effort is not None and reasoning_effort not in EFFORTS:
241	            raise ValueError(f"reasoning_effort must be one of {', '.join(EFFORTS)}")
242	        effort = reasoning_effort or self.reasoning_effort
243	        extra: dict[str, Any] = {}
244	        if effort == "none":
245	            extra["thinking"] = {"type": "disabled"}
246	        elif effort != "omit":
247	            # thinking mode ignores `temperature` (DeepSeek docs); it is sent anyway, harmlessly
248	            extra["thinking"] = {"type": "enabled"}
249	            extra["reasoning_effort"] = effort
250	        settings: ModelSettings = {"temperature": self.temperature, "max_tokens": self.max_tokens,
251	                                   "max_retries": 0,  # the loop retries (and charges) itself
252	                                   "framing_announcement": "never"}  # no SDK text added to our prompt
253	        if extra:
254	            settings["extra_body"] = extra
255	        return settings
256	
257	    def effort(self, reasoning_effort: str | None) -> str:
258	        return reasoning_effort or self.reasoning_effort
259	
260	    async def aclose(self) -> None:
261	        await self._http.aclose()
